title: The Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates
summary: Prescribes the functional and presentation currency framework and accounting for foreign currency transactions and exchange differences, converged with IAS 21, with a notable historical transitional difference for capitalisation of certain long-term monetary items.

bannerNotice.title: Ind AS — Converged with IAS 21, with a Notable Historical Transitional Difference
bannerNotice.body: Ind AS 21's functional/presentation currency framework and exchange difference recognition rules mirror IAS 21 closely. India historically permitted an OPTIONAL exemption (carried over from earlier Indian GAAP practice) allowing CAPITALISATION of exchange differences on certain long-term foreign currency monetary items into related asset cost, rather than immediate P&L recognition as IAS 21 requires — a transitional relief that has now LARGELY EXPIRED for most entities. Section 11 covers the full comparison.
